subject.title: feat(sessions): add local timezone prefix to archive filenames

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `YYYY-MM-DD_<UTC>` as the persisted session archive filename contract for timezone-aware local-date discovery?
rationale: The PR changes persisted transcript artifact names for configured users; maintainers need to own the filename contract even if the mechanical parser gap is repairable.

options.title: Adopt Prefix After Coverage
options.body: Require QMD/session-memory parser coverage plus real reset/delete proof, then accept the prefix as the compatibility-preserving filename contract.

options.title: Keep UTC Filenames
options.body: Decline the filename change and leave local-date discovery to tooling or a later metadata/display surface.

options.title: Choose Another Contract
options.body: Ask for a different naming or metadata approach before accepting any persisted archive filename change.

recommendation.title: Adopt Prefix After Coverage
recommendation.body: Require QMD/session-memory parser coverage plus real reset/delete proof, then accept the prefix as the compatibility-preserving filename contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Available blame points this person at the current artifact and QMD helper surfaces, making them the strongest routing owner among the evidence-backed likely owners.
